rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an enthusiastic admirer or fan of a person, group, or activity.

example.english: I’ve been a devotee of this team since I was little.
example.traditional: 我由細到大都係呢隊波嘅粉絲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hai6 ni1 deoi6 bo1 ge3 fan2 si1

rows.note: Use this for someone who believes in or follows a particular religion or god.

example.english: They are a devotee of Buddhism.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 kin4 sing4 ge3 fat6 gaau3 seon3 tou4
